topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays through strategies like ML-based path selection, latency-aware routing, and orbital configuration optimization. Integrating SDN, NFV, and edge computing enhances flexibility and reduces latency, while beamforming techniques mitigate interference.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms neglect high fixed latencies in satellite links, impacting performance.
